journey.name: Kicks: VS AI on-chain happy path
journey.description:
The money path the game exists for: one match that deploys its own contract, has the AI join it, commits both sides' picks and reveals them. Four contract calls, each proved on the device and finalized on chain, each paying its own dust fee from the wallet's UTXOs.
Nothing below is about the contracts. Every step here failed at least once on a real device for a reason no unit test and no localnet run could show: a spill the platform deleted mid-replay, a k=13 proof refused for want of free memory, a sigil gate no automated run could pass, a checkpoint that sat behind its own cursor. The sequence is cheap to assert and is the only thing that catches that class of failure.
Covers the deploy plus three of the penalty contract's circuits: joinMatch, commitRegulation and revealRegulation. The other three cannot be reached from a happy path and need journeys of their own: commitSuddenDeath and revealSuddenDeath only run when regulation ends level, claimTimeout needs a deadline to pass, and cancelMatch needs an abandoned match.
Preconditions this journey does NOT set up, and fails honestly without: - a debuggable build whose local.properties sets kuira.dev.seed, so there is a wallet without a passkey ceremony, and kuira.blockfrost.projectId, so PreProd answers at all; - that wallet funded on PreProd, with dust registered; - a device with room for a k=13 proof — about 366MB free AT PROVING TIME, which a 2GB emulator does not have once Unity is resident, however much it has at rest.
The first match on a wallet with no checkpoint spends ~12 minutes syncing dust before the deploy can pay its fee. That is expected, happens once per wallet per device, and the deploy sits on "Deploying match…" throughout.
